requirement: Phase254 must use existing local raw parquet roots only; no new Azure/raw downloads.
Phase254 must read buy/sell levels 1..5 price, quantity and order-count columns directly.
Ticks must be sorted by trade_date, exchange, symbol, collector_received_utc_ms and monotonic timestamp when present.
Event bars must use a declared receive-event clock and retain source tick counts per bar.
2026-07-17 and 2026-07-20 remain excluded from downstream parameter selection.
Outputs must include per-level, cumulative, weighted, slope/convexity and order-count features.
Outputs must include receive-order deltas for per-level quantity, price and order-count changes.
Outputs must check crossed/locked books, nonpositive quantities, missing levels and invalid sorting.
Downstream outputs must carry Zerodha modeled cost/spread floor fields before replay.
Phase253 is precommit only; no replay, promotion, paper/live or profitability claim.
